findings.value: page is 688px wide in a 390px viewport (2 children of main.page > section.stats reach 688px)
findings.why: Content wider than the screen forces sideways scrolling and hides content; WCAG 1.4.10 (Reflow) requires none at 320px.
findings.fix: Constrain the element: max-width: 100%, min-width: 0 on flex/grid children, wrap long words (overflow-wrap: anywhere), or let tables scroll inside their own container. Its children have min-width: 210px; let them wrap or stack (flex-wrap: wrap, or a grid with minmax).

findings.why: Part of the content is cut off with no sign it is there, so people miss information or controls.
findings.fix: Let the box grow (min-width: 0 on flex/grid children, no fixed width or height), wrap the content, or truncate deliberately with text-overflow: ellipsis and the full text in a tooltip or title.
